notes.en: Training positions (24) and test positions (106) are fixed and repeated every month; pooling months mixes 25 months of signal drift into one model.
notes.zh: 训练位置（24 个）和测试位置（106 个）每月固定重复；合并各月会把 25 个月的信号漂移混入同一个模型。

notes.en: The SVM cell is the slowest of the matrix (fit 4.3 minutes, prediction of the 81,120 test scans 17 minutes). Two earlier attempts hit the 30-minute limit while the shared cgroup was throttled on memory; the recorded run had no memory stall.
notes.zh: SVM 单元格是整个矩阵中最慢的（训练 4.3 分钟，预测 81,120 条测试样本 17 分钟）。此前两次尝试在共享控制组内存受限流时触及 30 分钟限制；记录下的这次运行没有内存停顿。

title.en: LongTermWiFi, the authors' protocol: train and test within each month (25 folds)
title.zh: LongTermWiFi，作者协议：每月内训练与测试（25 折）

dataset.name: longtermwifi
dataset.citation: Mendoza-Silva et al., Long-Term WiFi Fingerprinting Dataset for Research on Robust Indoor Positioning, Data 3(1):3, 2018, doi:10.3390/data3010003

protocol.name: benchmarks.protocols:WITHIN_MONTH
protocol.summary: the dataset authors' protocol: for every month m, train on m's training sets and test on m's test sets

skips.en: model-based: the dataset does not publish the access-point positions
skips.zh: 基于模型的方法：数据集未公开 AP 位置

notes.en: Pooled over the 25 monthly folds (every test scan once). Month 1 has 15 training sets and months 2-24 one each (576 scans per set); month 25 repeats its training set and its five test sets with a second phone (Galaxy A5), so that fold trains on both phones (1,152 scans) and tests on ten test sets (6,240 scans).
notes.zh: 对 25 个月度折叠合并统计（每条测试样本一次）。第 1 个月有 15 个训练集，第 2-24 个月各 1 个（每个 576 条）；第 25 个月用第二部手机（Galaxy A5）重复采集了训练集和五个测试集，因此该折用两部手机的训练集（1,152 条）训练、在十个测试集（6,240 条）上测试。
